# SS Trailers — Shahid Mehmood Salamat Auto General Repairing Co LLC

> Trailer and truck body manufacturer in Ras Al Khor, Dubai, UAE. Flatbed, tanker, tipper, sand, low bed, curtain, box, skeleton and custom trailers for UAE and GCC fleets.
